verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS applicant-tracking system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers Greenhouse's APIs, job boards, webhooks and AI features, but nothing indicates a public source repository or an open license. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
